m: You **sign** your name in **letters** on the line: you **sign**.
ex: 请在这里签字。
Please sign here.
合同上还没有经理的签字。
The contract doesn't have the manager's signature yet.
use: A separable verb: 签了字, 签个字. 签名 is a near synonym.

m: A **political** **change** made by force overnight: a **coup**.
ex: 那个国家发生了政变。
There was a coup in that country.
政变以后，军队控制了首都。
After the coup, the army took control of the capital.
use: Goes with 发生 (happen) and 发动 (launch).

m: There **are** **times** when you **wait**, and times you don't: **sometimes**.
ex: 我有时候走路上班。
Sometimes I walk to work.
有时候他很忙，有时候很闲。
Sometimes he is very busy, and sometimes he has lots of free time.
use: Spoken; 有时 is the shorter form. Can stand before or after the subject.

m: A **waterfall** spreads out like a sheet of **cloth**: a **waterfall**.
ex: 山上有一个大瀑布。
There is a big waterfall on the mountain.
我们站在瀑布下面拍了很多照片。
We stood below the waterfall and took lots of photos.
use: Measure word 条 or 道.

ex: 他咳嗽得很厉害。
He is coughing badly.
晚上睡觉的时候，孩子一直咳嗽。
The child kept coughing at night while sleeping.
use: Note the neutral tone: ké sou. Often with 一直 or 得很厉害.

ex: 她戴着一条水晶项链。
She is wearing a crystal necklace.
这个杯子是水晶做的，非常漂亮。
This glass is made of crystal and is very beautiful.
use: Means the mineral crystal or crystal glass.

m: A **mark** with a **number** on it: a **symbol** or **sign**.
ex: 这个符号是什么意思？
What does this symbol mean?
请在正确答案旁边画一个符号。
Please draw a mark next to the right answer.
use: Measure word 个. 标点符号 means punctuation marks.

ex: 武汉是华中最大的城市。
Wuhan is the biggest city in central China.
他在华中的一所大学读书。
He studies at a university in central China.
use: Like 华北 (north China) and 华南 (south China).

ex: 这匹军马跑得很快。
This warhorse runs very fast.
古代打仗离不开军马。
In ancient times, wars could not be fought without warhorses.
use: Measure word 匹.

ex: 这座宫殿非常辉煌。
This palace is magnificent.
他们公司过去有过很辉煌的历史。
Their company once had a glorious history.
use: Used for achievements, history, buildings, lights; often 辉煌的成就.

ex: 我对结果很失望。
I'm very disappointed with the result.
别让你的父母失望。
Don't let your parents down.
use: Pattern: 对…失望 (disappointed in…); 让…失望 (let … down).

m: Traits **left behind** and **passed on** to children: **heredity**, to **inherit**.
ex: 这种病会遗传。
This disease is hereditary.
他的高个子是从爸爸那里遗传的。
He inherited his height from his dad.
use: Biological only; for property use 继承.

m: An **abundant** **look** at things at a big **meeting**: an **exposition** or fair.
ex: 上海举办过世界博览会。
Shanghai once hosted a World Expo.
我们下个月去参加一个汽车博览会。
Next month we're going to a car fair.
use: Short form 博览; 世博会 is the World Expo.

ex: 经济在稳步发展。
The economy is developing steadily.
我们的销售额每年都在稳步增长。
Our sales are growing steadily every year.
use: Formal; used before verbs like 发展, 增长, 提高.

ex: 这本书印刷得很清楚。
This book is clearly printed.
现在很多杂志都不再印刷了。
Many magazines are no longer printed now.
use: For printers at home, 打印 is more common.

m: A **position** on the **lake** to tie up: a **berth** or parking space.
ex: 这个港口有二十个泊位。
This port has twenty berths.
小区里的停车泊位不够用。
There aren't enough parking spaces in the residential complex.
use: Formal; in speech 车位 is more common for parking.

m: An **ordered** **record** of the best result: a **record**.
ex: 他打破了世界纪录。
He broke the world record.
这次比赛有三个新纪录。
Three new records were set in this competition.
use: Used for sports records: 打破纪录, 创造纪录. For notes and the verb, use 记录.

m: **Shade** and **sun**, the two opposite forces: **yin and yang**.
ex: 中医讲阴阳平衡。
Chinese medicine talks about the balance of yin and yang.
阴阳是中国古代的一种哲学思想。
Yin and yang is a philosophical idea from ancient China.
天上有一弯新月。
There is a crescent moon in the sky.
傍晚的时候，西边出现了一弯新月。
At dusk, a crescent moon appeared in the west.
use: Measure word 弯 (a curve of) or 个.

m: **People** who **move** to a new country: to **immigrate**; an **immigrant**.
ex: 他们一家移民到了加拿大。
Their family emigrated to Canada.
这个城市有很多新移民。
This city has many new immigrants.
use: Both the act (移民到…) and the person.

m: How far you may **pass** before the **limit**: a **limit**.
ex: 我的耐心是有限度的。
My patience has its limits.
最低限度，你应该先打个电话。
At the very least, you should call first.
use: Often 最大限度 (to the greatest extent), 最低限度 (at least).

m: The **official**'s **home**: the **government**, or in old novels **the emperor**.
ex: 这块地是官家的。
This land belongs to the government.
在古代，老百姓很怕官家。
In ancient times, ordinary people were very afraid of the authorities.
use: Old-fashioned; heard in historical dramas.

ex: 她心里充满了恐惧。
Her heart was full of fear.
很多人对考试有恐惧心理。
Many people have a fear of exams.
use: More formal and stronger than 害怕.

ex: 太阳从西边落下。
The sun sets in the west.
我家西边有一个小公园。
There is a small park to the west of my home.
use: Spoken; 西面 and 西方 are near words. Pattern: X西边 = west of X.

ex: 会议延长了半个小时。
The meeting was extended by half an hour.
商店把营业时间延长到晚上十点。
The shop extended its opening hours to 10 p.m.
use: For time or length. Opposite: 缩短 (shorten).

ex: 这是一个已知的问题。
This is a known problem.
根据已知条件，我们可以算出答案。
From the known conditions, we can work out the answer.
use: Formal, used in maths and science; opposite 未知 (unknown).

ex: 我每天早上看日报。
I read the daily paper every morning.
这条新闻上了《人民日报》。
This news made it into the People's Daily.
use: Often part of newspaper names: 人民日报, 中国日报.

ex: 他听到消息马上赶来了。
He rushed over as soon as he heard the news.
医生从医院赶来，救了老人。
The doctor rushed over from the hospital and saved the old man.
use: Opposite direction: 赶去 (rush there).

ex: 这里的阳光很充足。
There's plenty of sunshine here.
考试前一定要有充足的睡眠。
Be sure to get enough sleep before an exam.
use: Goes with 时间, 阳光, 睡眠, 理由. Compare 足够 (enough).

m: One thing **substitutes** and **stands in for** another: to **replace**.
ex: 没有人能替代你。
No one can replace you.
电脑不能完全替代老师。
Computers can't completely replace teachers.
use: Slightly formal; 代替 means the same and is more common in speech.

ex: 这杯咖啡香味浓郁。
This coffee has a rich aroma.
这个小镇有浓郁的民族特色。
This little town has a strong ethnic character.
use: Goes with 香味, 气息, 色彩, 特色. Written style.

m: **Earth** **outside** your home area: **another part of the country**.
ex: 他是从外地来的。
He came from another part of the country.
很多外地人来北京工作。
Many people from other places come to Beijing to work.
use: 外地人 = non-local; 本地 = local. Not abroad (that's 外国).

m: Your **chief** skill, done on your own **authority**: to **be good at**.
ex: 她擅长画画。
She is good at painting.
我不擅长跟陌生人说话。
I'm not good at talking to strangers.
use: Followed by a noun or verb. Compare 善于, which is similar but more formal.

m: A **hot** **point**: a **hot spot**, a topic everyone talks about.
ex: 这是最近的热点新闻。
This is a hot news topic lately.
三亚是冬天的旅游热点。
Sanya is a tourist hot spot in winter.
use: Also a Wi-Fi hotspot: 开个热点 (turn on a hotspot).

m: Look in the **bronze mirror** and **fix** a verdict: to **appraise** or **authenticate**.
ex: 专家鉴定这幅画是真的。
The expert authenticated the painting as genuine.
这份鉴定报告明天出来。
The appraisal report will come out tomorrow.
use: Formal; for antiques, quality, evidence. 鉴定书 = appraisal certificate.

ex: 他是一条好汉。
He's a real hero.
不到长城非好汉。
You're not a real hero until you've climbed the Great Wall.
use: Measure word 条. Famous saying: 好汉不吃眼前亏.

m: **Rivers** and **mountains**: the land, the **country** or **state power**.
ex: 江山如此美丽。
The land is so beautiful.
他用了十年时间打下了江山。
He spent ten years conquering the country.
use: Literary; in history means the realm a ruler holds.

ex: 太阳的光辉照着大地。
The sun's radiance shines on the earth.
他为国家做出了光辉的贡献。
He made a glorious contribution to his country.
use: Formal; often 光辉的历史, 光辉形象.

ex: 小偷被当场抓住了。
The thief was caught on the spot.
他听完以后当场就同意了。
He agreed on the spot after hearing it.
use: Before the verb. Compare 现场 (the scene, a noun).

ex: 学生要遵守纪律。
Students must obey the rules.
这个队纪律很严，从来不迟到。
This team is very disciplined and never late.
use: Goes with 遵守 (obey) and 违反 (break).

ex: 我们要遵循这个原则。
We must follow this principle.
实验必须遵循安全规定。
The experiment must follow the safety regulations.
use: Formal; objects like 原则, 规律, 规定. 遵守 is more common for rules and laws.

ex: 这本书适合青少年读。
This book is suitable for teenagers.
很多青少年每天花几个小时玩手机。
Many teenagers spend several hours a day on their phones.
use: Covers roughly ages 10 to 20.

ex: 工人们在工厂门口抗议。
The workers protested at the factory gate.
对这个决定，他提出了强烈抗议。
He strongly protested against this decision.
use: Pattern: 对…提出抗议, 向…抗议.

ex: 科学家在探测海底。
Scientists are probing the sea floor.
这个机器可以探测地下的水。
This machine can detect water underground.
use: Technical; 探测器 = probe, detector.

ex: 很多国家谴责了这次袭击。
Many countries condemned the attack.
他的做法受到了大家的谴责。
What he did was condemned by everyone.
use: Formal and strong, used in news. Weaker: 批评 (criticise).

m: Walk on someone's **heels** and follow their **footprints**: to **tail**.
ex: 好像有人在跟踪我。
It seems someone is following me.
医生会继续跟踪他的病情。
The doctor will keep monitoring his condition.
use: Also "to track" a parcel, a project, a patient.

ex: 今年夏天很干旱。
This summer has been very dry.
干旱让很多庄稼死了。
The drought killed a lot of crops.
use: Opposite: 洪水 (flood) or 湿润 (humid).

m: The **air** of **power** around something: **imposing manner**, momentum.
ex: 这座山很有气势。
This mountain is very imposing.
他们一上场气势就很强。
They looked very powerful the moment they took the field.
use: Often 有气势 or 气势很大.

m: Food that is **hot** and **bitter**, like hard work: **exhausting**, **hard**.
ex: 你今天辛苦了。
You worked hard today. (Thanks for your trouble.)
他每天工作十二个小时，非常辛苦。
He works twelve hours a day; it's very hard.
use: 辛苦了 is a common way to thank someone for their effort.

m: The **topic** that catches your **eye**: a **title** or exam **question**.
ex: 这道题目太难了。
This question is too hard.
老师给我们出了一个作文题目。
The teacher gave us an essay topic.
use: Measure word 道 for exam questions, 个 for topics.

ex: 做饺子要用面粉。
You need flour to make dumplings.
妈妈去超市买了两袋面粉。
Mum went to the supermarket and bought two bags of flour.
use: Measure word 袋 (bag) or 斤 (half kilo).

m: The **ratio** at which you **remit** money: the **exchange rate**.
ex: 今天的汇率是多少？
What's today's exchange rate?
最近人民币对美元的汇率变化很大。
The yuan-to-dollar exchange rate has changed a lot recently.
use: Pattern: A对B的汇率 (rate of A against B).

m: **High** **layers**: a **high-rise**, or the **top level** of an organisation.
ex: 我家住在高层。
My home is in a high-rise.
公司高层下周开会讨论这件事。
The company's top management will meet next week to discuss it.
use: 高层建筑 = high-rise building; 高层领导 = senior leaders.

ex: 黑暗过去，光明就会来。
When the darkness passes, light will come.
年轻人的前途很光明。
Young people have a bright future.
use: Often figurative: 前途光明 (bright future).

m: A **scene** you see like a big **image**: a **sight**, a **scene**.
ex: 春天到处是一片新的景象。
In spring everything has a fresh look.
我从来没见过这么美的景象。
I've never seen such a beautiful sight.
use: Often 一片…的景象 (a scene of…).

ex: 他的成绩在班里名列前列。
His grades are among the top of the class.
我国在这方面走在世界前列。
Our country is at the forefront of the world in this area.
use: Fixed phrases: 走在前列, 名列前列. Written style.

m: Your heart **goes** **towards** a place: to **yearn for**.
ex: 我很向往大城市的生活。
I really long for life in a big city.
他从小就向往去西藏旅行。
He has dreamed of travelling to Tibet since he was little.
use: Object is a place, life or ideal. Compare 期待 (look forward to an event).

m: **Gas** that is **natural**, from the earth: **natural gas**.
ex: 我们家做饭用天然气。
We cook with natural gas at home.
这个地区的天然气很丰富。
This area is rich in natural gas.
use: 煤气 is coal gas; 天然气 is natural gas.

ex: 这是一件好事。
This is a good thing.
他做了好事，从来不说。
He does good deeds and never talks about them.
use: Measure word 件. Also sarcastic: 看你做的好事！ (Look what you've done!)

ex: 这支军队战斗力很强。
This army has great fighting strength.
我们队今天的战斗力不太行。
Our team's fighting spirit isn't great today.
use: Also used for sports teams and work teams.

m: **Wait** for a **period** of time with hope: to **look forward to**.
ex: 我很期待这次旅行。
I'm really looking forward to this trip.
谢谢大家，期待下次再见！
Thank you all, I look forward to seeing you next time!
use: Pattern: 期待着…, 对…有期待.

ex: 军方没有发表意见。
The military did not comment.
据军方消息，事故没有人受伤。
According to the military, no one was hurt in the accident.
use: News style; 方 means "side", as in 警方 (police).

ex: 这座古庙正在修缮。
This old temple is being renovated.
政府花了很多钱修缮这些老房子。
The government spent a lot of money renovating these old houses.
use: Formal; for buildings, temples, walls. Daily speech uses 修 or 装修.

ex: 他是研究光学的。
He does research in optics.
这家公司生产光学仪器。
This company makes optical instruments.
use: Also an adjective-like prefix: 光学镜头 (optical lens).

ex: 我很想念我的家乡。
I really miss my hometown.
我的家乡在南方的一个小城市。
My hometown is a small city in the south.
use: Near words: 老家 (spoken), 故乡 (literary).

m: Put your **essence** and **heart** in: **with great care**.
ex: 这是她精心准备的礼物。
This is a gift she prepared with great care.
在医生的精心照顾下，他很快好了。
Under the doctor's careful treatment, he soon got better.
use: Usually before verbs: 精心设计, 精心准备, 精心照顾.

ex: 我的生日在四月。
My birthday is in April.
四月的北京经常刮大风。
Beijing is often very windy in April.
use: Months are number + 月: 一月 to 十二月.

m: The **ministry** that **teaches** and **raises** people: the **Ministry of Education**.
ex: 教育部发了新通知。
The Ministry of Education issued a new notice.
教育部要求学校减少学生的作业。
The Ministry of Education asked schools to cut students' homework.
use: Other ministries also end in 部: 外交部, 卫生部.

ex: 我们赢得了比赛。
We won the match.
他的努力赢得了大家的尊重。
His hard work earned everyone's respect.
use: Object can be abstract: 赢得掌声, 赢得信任. 赢 alone is spoken.

ex: 你等了多久？
How long did you wait?
从这里到机场要多久？
How long does it take to get from here to the airport?
use: Only for time. 没多久 = not long after.

ex: 这是一个新兴的行业。
This is an emerging industry.
很多新兴城市发展得非常快。
Many emerging cities are growing very fast.
use: Formal; with 产业, 行业, 市场, 国家.

m: **Break into pieces** until it is **powder**: to **smash**, to **shatter**.
ex: 杯子掉在地上，摔得粉碎。
The cup fell to the floor and smashed to pieces.
他们粉碎了敌人的计划。
They foiled the enemy's plan.
use: Also figurative: 粉碎阴谋 (crush a plot).

ex: 他想超越自己。
He wants to surpass himself.
这个手机的销量已经超越了去年。
This phone's sales have already surpassed last year's.
use: Formal. Compare 超过 (exceed), which is more everyday.

m: Take the **position** at once: **succeed to the throne**.
ex: 他十岁就即位了。
He came to the throne at the age of ten.
新皇帝即位以后，做了很多改革。
After the new emperor took the throne, he made many reforms.
use: Historical; used for emperors and kings.

m: The **country**'s **teacher**: the **imperial teacher**, the state preceptor.
ex: 他是皇帝的国师。
He was the emperor's state preceptor.
古代的国师常常是有名的和尚。
In ancient times, the state preceptor was often a famous monk.
use: Historical; heard in period dramas.

m: Run a **business** from your **camp**: to **do business**, be **open**.
ex: 这家店二十四小时营业。
This shop is open 24 hours.
商场每天早上十点开始营业。
The mall opens for business at 10 a.m. every day.
use: 营业时间 = opening hours; 营业员 = shop assistant.

ex: 酒后开车是违法的。
Drink-driving is illegal.
他因为违法被警察抓走了。
He was taken away by the police for breaking the law.
use: Opposite 合法 (legal). 犯法 is close and more spoken.

ex: 半数以上的人同意。
More than half of the people agreed.
班里半数的学生没交作业。
Half the students in the class didn't hand in homework.
use: Often 半数以上 (over half). Written style.

ex: 他还是在校学生。
He's still a student.
在校期间，她参加了很多活动。
While at school, she took part in lots of activities.
use: Used before nouns: 在校学生, 在校期间.

ex: 把糖搅拌均匀。
Stir the sugar in evenly.
这个地区的雨水分布不均匀。
Rainfall in this region is unevenly distributed.
use: Often after verbs: 搅拌均匀, 分布均匀.

m: **Lose** the point by a **mistake**: a **slip**, an **error**.
ex: 这是我的失误。
That was my mistake.
他在比赛中失误了两次。
He made two errors in the match.
use: For slips in play or work. 错误 is more general.

m: The **wrist** of the **hand**: **wrist**; also **skill** at manipulating.
ex: 我的手腕有点疼。
My wrist hurts a bit.
这个人很有手腕，什么事都能办成。
This person is really shrewd and can get anything done.
use: Figurative sense (tactics) is often a little negative.

ex: 村民们都很热情。
The villagers are all very friendly.
这条新路是村民自己修的。
The villagers built this new road themselves.
use: Like 市民 (city residents), 居民 (residents).

ex: 他参加了数学竞赛。
He took part in a maths competition.
学校每年都举办知识竞赛。
The school holds a quiz contest every year.
use: For academic contests; 比赛 is more general, especially sports.

m: **Receive** a case and **handle** it: to **accept** (an application or case).
ex: 法院已经受理了这个案子。
The court has accepted the case.
这个窗口不受理签证申请。
This counter doesn't accept visa applications.
use: Official language: banks, courts, government offices.

m: A **province** as one **portion** of the country: a **province**.
ex: 中国有哪些省份？
Which provinces does China have?
他去过中国二十多个省份。
He has been to more than twenty Chinese provinces.
use: Not used with a name: say 广东省, not 广东省份.

ex: 他给爷爷磕头拜年。
He kowtowed to his grandpa to wish him a happy New Year.
过去，见到皇帝要磕头。
In the past, you had to kowtow when you met the emperor.
use: Separable: 磕了三个头.

ex: 他把钱隐藏在书里。
He hid the money inside a book.
她努力隐藏自己的感情。
She tried hard to hide her feelings.
use: Slightly formal; 藏 or 躲 is more spoken. 隐藏文件 = hidden file.

m: The **early** part of the day, **up** with the sun: **morning**.
ex: 早上好！
Good morning!
我每天早上七点起床。
I get up at seven every morning.
use: Spoken; 早晨 is close. 上午 is later, until noon.

ex: 两个国家结成了同盟。
The two countries formed an alliance.
这个同盟只维持了几年。
The alliance only lasted a few years.
use: 结成同盟 = form an alliance. 联盟 is a near word.

ex: 他如是说。
Thus he spoke.
我如是想，也如是做了。
I thought so, and I acted so.
use: Literary; mainly in writing and set phrases.

ex: 他是部队的政委。
He is the unit's political commissar.
政委和团长一起开会。
The commissar and the regiment commander held a meeting together.
use: Short for 政治委员.

ex: 这种风气现在很盛行。
This trend is very common now.
网上购物在年轻人中很盛行。
Online shopping is very popular among young people.
use: Often for customs and trends, sometimes negative. Compare 流行.

ex: 火车开进了隧道。
The train went into a tunnel.
这条隧道有五公里长。
This tunnel is five kilometres long.
use: Measure word 条.

ex: 天气变冷，衣服也随之变厚。
As the weather gets cold, clothes get thicker with it.
收入增加了，花费也随之增加。
As income went up, spending rose along with it.
use: Written; usually 随之 + verb, after a cause.

ex: 这个行业利润率很高。
This industry has high profit margins.
今年公司的利润率下降了。
The company's profit margin fell this year.
use: 利润 = profit; 率 = rate.

m: **Carved** and **red**: a name, the **Khitan** people of north China.
ex: 契丹人建立了辽国。
The Khitan people founded the Liao state.
历史书上写了很多契丹的故事。
History books tell many stories about the Khitan.
use: Historical; gives the old word "Cathay".

ex: 我想征求你的意见。
I'd like to ask your opinion.
学校正在征求家长的建议。
The school is asking parents for suggestions.
use: Object: 意见, 建议, 同意. Polite and formal.

m: **Plant** and **bank up earth**: to **cultivate**; also to **train** a person.
ex: 这里栽培了很多花。
Many flowers are grown here.
谢谢老师多年的栽培。
Thank you, teacher, for years of guidance.
use: Second sense is polite: thanking someone who trained you.

m: A **carving** that **floats** out from the wall: a **relief**.
ex: 墙上有一幅浮雕。
There is a relief on the wall.
这些石头浮雕已经有一千年了。
These stone reliefs are already a thousand years old.
use: Measure word 幅 or 块.

ex: 农民用河水灌溉农田。
Farmers irrigate the fields with river water.
没有水灌溉，庄稼长不好。
Without water for irrigation, crops won't grow well.
use: Formal; daily speech says 浇水 (water plants).

ex: 他没有任何特权。
He has no special privileges.
在法律面前，谁都不能有特权。
Before the law, nobody may have privileges.
use: Usually negative in Chinese, like "special treatment".

m: A **leaf** plus the noun ending **子**: a **leaf**.
ex: 秋天叶子变黄了。
In autumn the leaves turn yellow.
风一吹，树上的叶子掉了一地。
When the wind blew, leaves from the tree fell all over the ground.
use: Measure word 片.

m: **Tools** used along the **road** of a show: a **prop**.
ex: 这把刀只是道具。
This knife is just a prop.
演出前，他们准备了很多道具。
Before the show they prepared many props.
use: Also items in video games.

ex: 老人和孩子优先上车。
The elderly and children board first.
我们应该优先解决这个问题。
We should solve this problem first.
use: 优先 + verb = do first. 优先权 = priority right.

ex: 公司每年都要审计。
The company is audited every year.
审计发现了很多问题。
The audit uncovered many problems.
use: Finance term; 审计师 = auditor.

m: Where the **fart** comes from, above the **thigh**: the **bottom**.
ex: 他坐得屁股都疼了。
He sat so long his bottom hurt.
小孩子摔了一跤，屁股着地。
The little child fell and landed on his bottom.
use: Spoken and informal, but not rude.

m: The **reason** you **think** about: an **idea**, a guiding **concept**.
ex: 我们的教育理念不同。
We have different ideas about education.
这家公司的理念是顾客第一。
This company's philosophy is "customer first".
use: Formal; for principles behind work or design. Plain "idea" is 主意 or 想法.

ex: 你记住我的电话了吗？
Did you memorise my phone number?
请记住，明天八点准时到。
Please remember to arrive at eight sharp tomorrow.
use: 住 shows the result: it sticks. Negative: 记不住 (can't remember).

ex: 这里的旅游业很发达。
Tourism is well developed here.
疫情让旅游业受到了很大影响。
The pandemic hit the tourism industry hard.
use: 业 = industry, as in 服务业, 农业.

ex: 他对下属很好。
He treats his subordinates well.
经理让下属把报告改一下。
The manager asked his subordinate to revise the report.
use: Opposite: 上级 or 领导 (superior).

ex: 贵州有很多山。
Guizhou has many mountains.
我们打算国庆节去贵州旅游。
We plan to visit Guizhou for National Day.
use: Short name: 黔. Capital: 贵阳.

ex: 那里有很多高山。
There are many high mountains there.
他们爬上了一座四千米的高山。
They climbed a four-thousand-metre mountain.
use: Measure word 座.

ex: 这件事让世人震惊。
This shocked the world.
他的作品被世人记住了。
His work has been remembered by the world.
use: Literary; speech says 大家 or 人们.

m: The **owner** who **weaves** the pages together: the **editor in chief**.
ex: 她是这本杂志的主编。
She is the editor in chief of this magazine.
这本词典是王教授主编的。
This dictionary was edited by Professor Wang.
use: Also a verb: to be chief editor of.

m: **Grasp** the reins and steer: to **operate**, to **control** or **manipulate**.
ex: 他会操纵这台机器。
He can operate this machine.
有人在背后操纵这件事。
Someone is pulling the strings behind this.
use: Often negative: 操纵市场 (manipulate the market). Compare 操作 (operate).

ex: 他是公司的首席科学家。
He is the company's chief scientist.
首席执行官下午会见记者。
The CEO will meet reporters this afternoon.
use: Before job titles: 首席执行官 (CEO), 首席代表.

m: **Use** this step to be **spared** something: **so as not to**.
ex: 带把伞，以免下雨。
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
你快点儿走吧，以免迟到。
Hurry up and go so you won't be late.
use: Starts the second clause. Compare 免得, which is more spoken.

ex: 房租要预付三个月。
Three months' rent must be paid in advance.
订酒店的时候需要预付一半。
You need to pay half in advance when booking the hotel.
use: 预付卡 = prepaid card.

ex: 请安静一下。
Please be quiet for a moment.
这里很安静，适合看书。
It's very quiet here, good for reading.
use: 安静点儿 = be quieter. Compare 平静 (calm, of feelings).

ex: 敌人的火力很猛。
The enemy's firepower was fierce.
他们集中火力攻击对方。
They concentrated their fire on the other side.
use: Also figurative: criticism aimed at someone.

m: The **point** where you **rise** and start: the **starting point**.
ex: 我们回到了起点。
We returned to the starting point.
毕业只是人生的一个新起点。
Graduation is just a new starting point in life.
use: Opposite: 终点 (finish line).

ex: 每个人都要来，你也不例外。
Everyone has to come, and you're no exception.
这次是个例外，下次不行。
This time is an exception; not next time.
use: 不例外 = no exception. 毫无例外 = without exception.

ex: 这是常规检查。
This is a routine check-up.
我们要打破常规，想新办法。
We need to break with convention and think of new ways.
use: 常规武器 = conventional weapons; 打破常规 = break convention.

m: **Devote** your **power** to something: to **dedicate oneself to**.
ex: 他一直致力于环境保护。
He has long devoted himself to protecting the environment.
这家公司致力于开发新能源。
This company is dedicated to developing new energy.
use: Formal; almost always 致力于 + aim.

ex: 这两张桌子高低不一样。
These two tables are different heights.
我们俩比一比，分个高低。
Let's compete and see who's better.
use: 分个高低 = see who is better.

ex: 他到官府告状。
He went to the authorities to file a complaint.
那时候，官府的税很重。
Back then, the government's taxes were heavy.
use: Historical; heard in period dramas.

m: Even if it goes **vertically** wrong, it's still **so**: **even if**.
ex: 纵然很难，我也要试试。
Even if it's hard, I'll still try.
纵然失败了，我们也不后悔。
Even if we fail, we won't regret it.
use: Literary; followed by 也. Speech uses 即使 or 就算.

ex: 他的肠子有问题。
He has a problem with his intestines.
我后悔得肠子都青了。
I regret it so much. (My guts have turned green.)
use: Spoken; used in jokey expressions of regret.

ex: 她的回答让我很惊讶。
Her answer surprised me.
听到这个消息，大家都很惊讶。
Everyone was amazed to hear the news.
use: Pattern: 让…很惊讶; 对…感到惊讶. Near word: 吃惊.

m: The **great** **meeting** **hall** of the **people**: the **Great Hall of the People**, a name.
ex: 人民大会堂在天安门广场西边。
The Great Hall of the People is west of Tiananmen Square.
我们参观了人民大会堂。
We visited the Great Hall of the People.
use: China's parliament meets here.

ex: 你是会员吗？
Are you a member?
会员买东西可以打八折。
Members get 20% off their purchases.
use: 会员卡 = membership card.

ex: 我的肩膀很疼。
My shoulder really hurts.
他拍了拍我的肩膀，说没关系。
He patted me on the shoulder and said it was fine.
use: 肩 alone is more formal.

ex: 风暴快要来了。
A storm is about to come.
这场风暴让很多船不能出海。
The storm kept many boats from going out to sea.
use: Measure word 场. Also figurative: 金融风暴 (financial storm).

m: A **matter** you **go back** to: what a thing is.
ex: 这是怎么回事？
What's going on here?
说是一回事，做又是另一回事。
Saying is one thing; doing is another.
use: Mostly in 怎么回事 and 一回事. Note: 不当回事 = not take seriously.

ex: 不要忽视这个问题。
Don't overlook this problem.
他太忙了，忽视了家人。
He was so busy he neglected his family.
use: Formal; speech says 不注意 or 不管.

m: Use a **finger** to **touch** on the point: to **give pointers**.
ex: 请您多多指点。
Please give me lots of advice.
在老师的指点下，他进步很快。
With the teacher's guidance, he improved quickly.
use: Polite when asking an expert. 指指点点 = gossip, point at.

ex: 音乐能激发灵感。
Music can spark inspiration.
好老师会激发学生的兴趣。
Good teachers spark students' interest.
use: Objects: 兴趣, 热情, 灵感, 潜力.

m: Form a lasting **union** and tie the **knot**: to **conclude** (a treaty).
ex: 两国缔结了和平条约。
The two countries concluded a peace treaty.
他们在这里缔结了婚约。
They became engaged here.
use: Formal; with 条约, 协定, 婚约.

ex: 这是一片住宅区。
This is a residential area.
这栋住宅有一百多年历史了。
This house is over a hundred years old.
use: Formal; speech says 房子 or 家.

ex: 北京的冬天很冷。
Winters in Beijing are cold.
冬天到了，我们去滑雪吧。
Winter's here, let's go skiing.
use: Also 冬季 (more formal).

ex: 我的梦想是当医生。
My dream is to become a doctor.
他从小就梦想去月球。
He has dreamed of going to the moon since childhood.
use: For sleeping dreams use 梦.

ex: 湿地里有很多鸟。
There are many birds in the wetland.
我们要保护这片湿地。
We must protect this wetland.
use: 湿地公园 = wetland park.

ex: 公司正在开拓海外市场。
The company is opening up overseas markets.
读书可以开拓我们的眼界。
Reading can broaden our horizons.
use: With 市场, 眼界, 领域, 新路.

m: The **mould** and its **number**: the **model** of a product.
ex: 你的手机是什么型号？
What model is your phone?
这两个型号的电脑价格差不多。
These two computer models cost about the same.
use: Measure word 个 or 种.

ex: 祝你周末愉快！
Have a nice weekend!
我们度过了一个愉快的晚上。
We spent a pleasant evening.
use: In wishes: 旅途愉快, 生日愉快. 快乐 is close.

m: Those who come **after** and **take the place** of you: **descendants**.
ex: 他是孔子的后代。
He is a descendant of Confucius.
我们要为后代保护好地球。
We must protect the earth for future generations.
use: Also "future generations" in general. 子孙 is close.

ex: 他猛地站了起来。
He suddenly stood up.
车猛地停下，我差点儿摔倒。
The car stopped suddenly and I almost fell.
use: Before an action verb. Here 地 is pronounced de.

ex: 狮子是动物之王。
The lion is the king of beasts.
我们在动物园看见了两只狮子。
We saw two lions at the zoo.
use: Measure word 头 or 只. 狮子座 = Leo.

m: What your **life** is **made** to do: a **mission**.
ex: 这是我们的使命。
This is our mission.
每一代人都有自己的历史使命。
Every generation has its own historic mission.
use: Serious word; 任务 is an ordinary task.

m: A **college** that **teaches** how to be a **teacher** and **model**: a **teachers' college**.
ex: 她在师范学院学习。
She studies at a teachers' college.
他从师范学院毕业以后当了老师。
He became a teacher after graduating from teachers' college.
use: 师范大学 is the university-level version.

m: Someone on **special** **affairs**: a **secret agent**, a spy.
ex: 他原来是特务。
It turns out he was a spy.
电影里的特务都很会打架。
The secret agents in films are all good fighters.
use: Note the neutral tone: tè wu. 间谍 is close.

ex: 他们之间有纠纷。
They have a dispute between them.
这起纠纷最后由法院解决了。
The dispute was finally settled by the court.
use: With 发生, 解决, 处理.

ex: 他是学考古的。
He studied archaeology.
考古学家在这里发现了一座古墓。
Archaeologists found an ancient tomb here.
use: 考古学 = the field; 考古学家 = archaeologist.

ex: 最近股市很好。
The stock market is doing well lately.
他在股市上赔了很多钱。
He lost a lot of money on the stock market.
use: 炒股 = trade stocks. 股 here means share.

ex: 他犹豫了一下才回答。
He hesitated a moment before answering.
别犹豫了，快决定吧！
Stop hesitating and decide!
use: 犹豫不决 = can't make up one's mind.

ex: 他的举动很奇怪。
His behaviour is strange.
这个小举动让我很感动。
This small gesture really touched me.
use: Formal-ish; for one action. 行为 is behaviour in general.

ex: 他是公司的董事。
He is a director of the company.
董事们下午开会。
The board members are meeting this afternoon.
use: 董事会 = board of directors; 董事长 = chairman.

m: The **temple** in the **young** **woods**: the **Shaolin Temple**, a name.
ex: 少林寺在河南。
The Shaolin Temple is in Henan.
很多外国人来少林寺学功夫。
Many foreigners come to the Shaolin Temple to learn kung fu.
use: Famous for kung fu monks.

m: **Working** **people** of the same **rank** and **level**: the **working class**.
ex: 他出身于工人阶级。
He comes from the working class.
那本书写的是工人阶级的生活。
That book is about working-class life.
use: Political term; 中产阶级 = middle class.

m: **Provide** and **offer** to gods: to **enshrine** and worship.
ex: 庙里供奉着一尊佛像。
A statue of the Buddha is enshrined in the temple.
他家里供奉着祖先的牌位。
His home has a shrine to his ancestors.
use: Used for gods, Buddhas and ancestors.

ex: 我想尝试一下新方法。
I want to try a new method.
这是一次很有意义的尝试。
This was a very meaningful attempt.
use: More formal than 试试.

ex: 他的牙齿很白。
His teeth are very white.
每天要刷两次牙齿。
You should brush your teeth twice a day.
use: Speech often uses just 牙: 刷牙, 牙疼.

ex: 新手难免会犯错。
Beginners are bound to make mistakes.
第一次做饭，难免有点儿紧张。
It's natural to be a bit nervous cooking for the first time.
use: Often 难免会…. Means "bound to happen".

m: A **platform** that sends **electric** waves: a **radio station**.
ex: 我喜欢听这个电台。
I like listening to this radio station.
他在电台当主持人。
He's a host at a radio station.
use: Measure word 家 or 个. 广播 = broadcast.

ex: 警察正在执法。
The police are enforcing the law.
执法人员要公正。
Law enforcement officers must be fair.
use: 执法部门 = law-enforcement agencies.

ex: 你会说几门外语？
How many foreign languages can you speak?
学外语最重要的是多练习。
The most important thing in learning a foreign language is practice.
use: Measure word 门 or 种.

ex: 这里人口很密集。
The population is very dense here.
最近工作很密集，我没时间休息。
Work has been very intense lately; I've had no time to rest.
use: Also 密集训练 (intensive training).

m: **Lift** the lid so it **rises**: to **lift**; to **set off** a wave.
ex: 她掀起了盖子。
She lifted the lid.
这部电影掀起了一股学功夫的热潮。
This film set off a craze for learning kung fu.
use: Often 掀起…热潮/高潮 (start a craze/wave).

ex: 你的体重是多少？
How much do you weigh?
这个月我的体重减了三公斤。
I lost three kilos this month.
use: Goes with 增加, 减轻, 控制.

ex: 这里有很多儿童图书。
There are many children's books here.
我每周去一次图书馆借书。
I go to the library once a week to borrow books.
use: Collective, formal; one book is 一本书. 图书馆 = library.

ex: 我第一次看到大海。
It was my first time seeing the sea.
我们住的地方离大海很近。
Where we live is very close to the sea.
use: Used for the open sea in general.

ex: 山下有个水库。
There's a reservoir at the foot of the mountain.
这个水库给全市供水。
This reservoir supplies water to the whole city.
use: Measure word 座 or 个.

ex: 他发誓要报仇。
He swore to take revenge.
他想为父亲报仇。
He wants to avenge his father.
use: Pattern: 为…报仇 (avenge someone). Separable: 报了仇.

ex: 我们在中山公园见面吧。
Let's meet at Zhongshan Park.
周末中山公园里人很多。
Zhongshan Park is very crowded at weekends.
use: Many Chinese cities have a 中山公园 or 中山路.

ex: 我小弟今年十岁。
My little brother is ten this year.
小弟初来乍到，请多关照。
I'm new here, please look after me.
use: Humble self-reference is jokey and spoken, mostly among men.

ex: 这座城市有五百万人。
This city has five million people.
他买彩票中了一百万。
He won a million on the lottery.
use: Chinese counts in 万 (10,000): 一百万 = 1,000,000.

ex: 我今年十六岁。
I'm sixteen this year.
我们班一共有十六个女生。
There are sixteen girls in our class in total.
这样做不合乎规定。
Doing it this way doesn't conform to the rules.
他的回答很合乎逻辑。
His answer is very logical.
use: Formal; objects like 规定, 要求, 逻辑. Speech uses 符合.

m: **Hole** and **bright**: a name, **Kongming**, Zhuge Liang's courtesy name.
ex: 孔明是一个很聪明的人。
Kongming was a very clever man.
《三国演义》里的孔明非常有名。
Kongming in Romance of the Three Kingdoms is very famous.
use: Used as a byword for a wise strategist.

ex: 这家厂商生产手机。
This manufacturer makes phones.
很多汽车厂商都在降价。
Many car makers are cutting prices.
use: Measure word 家.

ex: 我喜欢吃牛肉面。
I like beef noodles.
这家店的牛肉做得特别好吃。
The beef at this restaurant is especially tasty.
use: Measure word 斤 or 块.

ex: 警察说他不是自杀。
The police say it wasn't suicide.
自杀不能解决任何问题。
Suicide solves nothing.
use: Serious word; handle with care.

ex: 你会骑马吗？
Can you ride a horse?
我们在草原上骑马骑了一下午。
We rode horses on the grassland all afternoon.
use: 骑 is for things you sit astride: 骑车, 骑马.

ex: 我很崇拜我的爸爸。
I really look up to my dad.
很多孩子崇拜运动明星。
Many children idolise sports stars.
use: Stronger than 佩服 (admire).

ex: 这是一个难得的机遇。
This is a rare opportunity.
年轻人要抓住机遇。
Young people must seize their opportunities.
use: Formal; speech uses 机会. 抓住机遇 = seize the chance.

m: **Turn** and **enter**: to **switch to**, to transfer into.
ex: 他转入了别的学校。
He transferred to another school.
会议很快转入了正题。
The meeting quickly turned to the main topic.
use: Also money: 转入账户 (transfer into an account).

ex: 那时候女人地位低下。
Women had a low status back then.
他的工作效率很低下。
His work efficiency is very low.
use: Written; with 地位, 水平, 效率. Compare 低下头 (lower one's head), a verb.

m: **Differentiate** right from wrong and **decide**: a court **judgment**.
ex: 法院今天判决了。
The court passed judgment today.
他对判决结果不满意。
He is not satisfied with the verdict.
use: Legal term; 判 alone is spoken: 判了五年.

ex: 他是学物理学的。
He studied physics.
爱因斯坦是有名的物理学家。
Einstein was a famous physicist.
use: Speech often says 物理 alone. 物理学家 = physicist.

ex: 我去过土耳其。
I've been to Turkey.
土耳其在亚洲和欧洲之间。
Turkey lies between Asia and Europe.
use: Chosen for sound; the characters' meanings don't matter.

m: The **chief** for the **outside** world: the **foreign minister**.
ex: 两国外长见了面。
The two foreign ministers met.
外长明天要访问日本。
The foreign minister will visit Japan tomorrow.
use: Short for 外交部长. News style.

ex: 这幅画描绘了春天。
This painting depicts spring.
他向我们描绘了未来的生活。
He described to us what life will be like in future.
use: Written; speech uses 描写 or 说.

ex: 这是一个县级市。
This is a county-level city.
这个县级市人口不到五十万。
This county-level city has fewer than half a million people.
use: Chinese admin term; 地级市 is prefecture-level.

ex: 回家途中下起了雨。
It started raining on the way home.
在去机场的途中，我们遇到了堵车。
On the way to the airport, we hit a traffic jam.
use: Written; speech uses 路上. Pattern: 在…途中.

m: **Chaste-tree** **river**: **Jingjiang**, a stretch of the Yangtze, a name.
ex: 荆江在湖北境内。
The Jingjiang is in Hubei.
荆江这一段河道弯弯曲曲。
This Jingjiang stretch of river winds a lot.
use: Part of the 长江 (Yangtze).

ex: 欧洲一直在推进经济一体化。
Europe has been pushing economic integration.
这几个城市正在推进交通一体化。
These cities are pushing forward transport integration.
use: Formal and political; with 经济, 区域.

m: **Coming** but **not** **reaching** in time: there's **not enough time**.
ex: 快走吧，来不及了！
Hurry, we won't make it!
我来不及吃早饭就出门了。
I didn't have time to eat breakfast before I left.
use: Opposite: 来得及 (there's still time).

ex: 这张纸两面都写满了字。
Both sides of this paper are covered in writing.
每件事都有两面。
Everything has two sides.
use: 两面派 = two-faced person.

ex: 顺着这条路一直走。
Follow this road straight on.
你别总顺着孩子，他会被宠坏的。
Don't always give in to the child, or he'll get spoiled.
use: Also "to go along with" someone's wishes.
